tokens.v: Planning compares the receipts it has with what is needed and writes a message wherever they differ: reschedule in, reschedule out, cancel, negative inventory, or an error that stops an order being planned or transferred. The messages are made during order planning, kept until the next run, and filed under the planner of each plan item, or a blank planner where there is none.
